description: This file handles the deletion step for a user role in the vtiger CRM system. It processes the role ID, retrieves the role name, prepares a Smarty template for displaying the delete confirmation UI including theme and image paths, and outputs the DeleteRole.tpl template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class tailored for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input to prevent security issues.

methods.name: getRoleName
methods.description: Retrieves the role name given a role ID.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language-specific labels for a module.

methods.name: vtiger_imageurl
methods.description: Generates the full URL for an image asset based on theme.
